content.text: Provide a simple Person register: named individuals with an age, creatable, editable and browsable through the platform's standard screens. Serves as a basic reference entity for this deployment.
In: a Person entity holding a name and an age, with the platform's standard create/edit/search screens.
Out: any relationship from Person to other entities (no addresses, no roles, no references); any lifecycle beyond plain create/edit/delete; any import or integration.
None — the bean's standard screens cover plain create, edit and browse; no ordered journey beyond that.
None — every rule is carried by the bean table.
No relationships. No uniqueness rules — multiple people may share a name.
The bean's search screen and edit form — platform defaults.
None — new entity, nothing to build on.
Considered, none apply: authorization, performance, volume, availability, audit, privacy, locale, cost.
None — the platform's generated tests cover the table rules.
None — new entity, no existing rows, users or callers to migrate.
A Person entity with its search screen and edit form.
Implied by the bean blocks in the Data model and regenerated by the platform - do not edit this block; author above it what the catalog cannot derive.

Person - persistence.entity (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entity-descriptor attachment (entity_descriptors/{qualified-descriptor-name}.json).
Person - observer.sheet (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

Person - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js attachment and shipped beside the entity class.
Person.age - validation.rule (persistence): min(0) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test
